title: curriculum/slo.yaml -- the Student Learning Outcomes and the course coverage grid
description: The backbone every SLO-anchored task tags to. Structural layer only; the cross-file rules (a coverage cell naming an undeclared outcome, a task tag naming an undeclared SLO) are enforced by ida_core.curriculum and tools/validate_tasks.py.

source.description: Where the outcomes and the grid were transcribed from. Required: an outcome list with no cited source is an assertion, not a record.

source_last_modified.description: The 'last modified' the source itself reports, if it reports one.

retrieved.description: The date the source was read. Separate from source_last_modified because a curriculum map is edited in place: a later disagreement should be attributable to a moved goalpost rather than blamed on the transcription.

outcomeId.description: Uppercase, no space, no separator: SLO1 .. SLO9. This exact spelling is what an `slo:<ID>` task tag must carry.

statement.description: The outcome as the programme publishes it. Reworded only to expand ampersands; not paraphrased.

text_benchmarkable.description: Whether a single-turn text benchmark can measure this outcome at all. Recorded rather than assumed: it is false for two of the nine, and a benchmark that silently dropped them would misrepresent the programme.

benchmark_note.description: Required in both directions. For a benchmarkable outcome: why it is scored the way it is. For a non-benchmarkable one: why not, so the omission is a stated decision rather than a gap.

id.description: This exact spelling is what a `use-mode:<id>` task tag must carry.

in_use.description: False declares a mode's spelling before anyone authors against an invented one. A task may only tag a mode that is in use.

course.description: Course code as the map prints it, e.g. 'MIS 200'.

outcomes.description: Only the cells the published map fills in. An omitted key means the map does not mark that pair -- NOT that the level is unknown.

^SLO[1-9][0-9]*$.description: Introduced / Reinforced / Mastered / Assessment Point / Mastered + Assessment Point.
